paragraphs: [Shabbat 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.29b.8) relates that the synagogue head of Batzra dragged a bench before Rabbi Yirmiyah the Great. Hyman infers from that passage that he lived before Rav Yosef and considers it very likely that he is the unqualified Rabbi Yirmiyah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Hebrew paragraph and the Davidson translation describe dragging the bench before Yirmiyah. The chronology and proposed identification with the unqualified Yirmiyah remain Hyman’s inferences.

The linked Shabbat names Yirmiyah the Great and the head of the synagogue at Batzra. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2243&lang=en) cites the same episode. The relative chronology and proposed identification with the unqualified Yirmiyah are Hyman’s inferences.
